title: Tool capabilities
description: What the repository's tooling can do for a contributor and for CI.

entities.name: Structural checks of the specification material
entities.description: Checks that the schema, the conformance material and the specification's JSON examples agree with each other.
entities.responsibility: Fails when a schema is not valid Draft 2020-12, a conformance example is accepted or rejected wrongly, an embedded spec example or a fixture value breaks the schema, fixture or scenario ids repeat, or the falsehoods matrix and its scenarios disagree.
access: Nothing checks: anyone with a checkout and jsonschema installed can run it; CI runs it on every push and pull request.

entities.name: Side-by-side page
entities.description: Builds the cross-language page of everyday tasks from code that is compiled and run as tests.
entities.responsibility: Lays out each of the 18 tasks in SECTIONS with the marked UTV-first test code of C#, Java, Python, TypeScript and Rust, and tells whether docs/side-by-side.md is current.
access: Nothing checks: a local script; CI runs it with --check.

relatedViews.relationship: The commands through which they are reached.
